name: tasks
description:
The project's task board (.agent/tasks.md): work that outlives this session — as opposed to todo, which is your checklist for the task at hand.

- list: show the board. add: a new item (to todo unless you say). move: an item to todo, doing or done. remove: drop an item.
- Add what the user asks you to remember or what you find that should be done later; move items as you work on them. Refer to items by their number.
